annotations.title: String utilities: every case, slug, counts and more

description: Transform one string every common way at once: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, dot.case, path/case, Title Case, Sentence case, upper and lower; a URL slug (accents removed); reversed; trimmed and whitespace-collapsed; and counts of characters, letters, digits, words and lines. Splits identifiers like userIDValue or XMLHttpRequest correctly. Use when naming fields, files and routes or cleaning user input. Example: text=Hello World, user profile ID 42.
